hardware_used: NVIDIA GB10 (Grace-Blackwell, aarch64, 121.7 GB unified memory), 1 GPU
notes: Single ALIGNN 2.0 models (pure-PyTorch reimplementation), k-nearest-neighbor graph (8 A cutoff, 12 neighbors, full line graph). Published ALIGNN training recipe (lr 1e-3 one-cycle, batch 64, weight decay 1e-5, 4 ALIGNN + 4 GCN layers, 300 epochs, best-validation-checkpoint evaluation) with hidden width 768. Per property, the config was chosen on the validation split only over variants of the published recipe (hidden width 256/512/768; for optb88vdw_bandgap also EMA, learning rate, weight decay; for optb88vdw_total_energy also a formation-energy-tuned recipe and its width-768 combination). For the bandgaps, three torch-seed replicas of the selected width-768 config were trained and the validation-best replica is submitted: optb88vdw_bandgap torch_seed 231 (test MAE 0.12449 eV), mbj_bandgap torch_seed 312 (test MAE 0.25763 eV); optb88vdw_total_energy is a single run, torch_seed 123 (test MAE 0.02965 eV/atom). Trained on the exact benchmark splits (keep_data_order with the benchmark's train/val/test ordering). Added 09-26-2026: ehull (test MAE 0.05136 eV/atom), bulk_modulus_kv (9.242 GPa) and spillage (0.3408), each a single width-768 run of the same published recipe with torch_seed 123 and no per-property selection, trained on the exact benchmark splits; time_taken_seconds are the measured single-GPU wall times on one GB10. ehull was interrupted by a node failure after 52 completed epochs and resumed from its checkpoint; its time is the sum of both segments (20,982 s, from job start to the log's last write at the failure, and 96,588 s). Note that the official ehull benchmark lists three ids (JVASP-100669, JVASP-116461, JVASP-96735) in both its train and test sets; the dataset reproduces the benchmark files as published, so this entry shares that overlap with every other ehull contribution.
